english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone complies without protesting.

exampleSentences.english: I compliantly handed over my phone without saying a word.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我冇出聲，乖乖咁交低部手機。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 mou5 ceot1 seng1 gwaai1 gwaai1 gam3 gaau1 dai1 bou6 sau2 gei1

english.note: This is the all-purpose casual way to say that someone complies obediently or without resistance.

exampleSentences.english: When they told me not to make a sound, I docilely sat there.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢叫我唔好出聲，我就乖乖咁坐喺度。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 giu3 ngo5 m4 hou2 ceot1 seng1 ngo5 zau6 gwaai1 gwaai1 gam3 co5 hai2 dou6

english.note: Use this when the dutiful action especially involves obediently doing what one is told or expected to do.

exampleSentences.english: The boss told us to hand in a report before we left, and we dutifully did it.
exampleSentences.traditional: 老闆叫我哋收工前交份報告，我哋就乖乖咁做。
exampleSentences.jyutping: lou5 baan2 giu3 ngo5 dei6 sau1 gung1 cin4 gaau1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 dei6 zau6 gwaai1 gwaai1 gam3 zou6
